name: hemingway-bridge
description: The Hemingway bridge for Claude Code: stop while it is going well, write down the next sentence, and let the next session pick it up in seconds.

plugins.name: bridge
plugins.description: Hemingway bridge for Claude Code sessions. /bridge writes a forward-looking note when you stop (next sentence, where I stopped, status, details that will be forgotten, intention, open loops); a SessionStart hook shows open bridges to the next session, and "resume" reads the note, verifies it, marks it crossed and does the next sentence instead of re-exploring. Plain Markdown, Obsidian optional, bash only, sends nothing.
